text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your hard work,
Cheval-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And for that, I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... T-Thanks...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To be able to compete with you like this
in the first race of the autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Being able to battle someone as strong as you
has provided me with immense sustenance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There is a back that I yearn to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The back of Kura-chan, carrying the same Satono mission,
and Kita-chan, with whom I shared and supported each other's dreams—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The desire not to lose to them, to be an opponent
they can respect, is what forged my running into what it is today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race will surely
give that an extra push as well."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Your back is also one of the guiding lights
that I aspire to surpass."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I thank you.
And—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Should another opportunity arise,
I will be sure to show you the fruits
of everything I've learned here."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing. With such...
With such a reliable girl, I—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I ran a good race...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Cheval Grand put her summer experiences to good use, putting on a magnificent performance in the Kyoto Daishoten...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the very next day...
choice_data_list: Alright, moving right along to our next target race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand swallowed hard with bated breath.
She, too, could likely predict
the words that would follow.
choice_data_list: Think you can do it? The 'Japan Cup'.
Do you think we can do it? The 'Japan Cup'.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going... to fulfill
my promise to Shine...!"
choice_data_list: Then our next goal is the Japan Cup!
Then our next goal is the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Alright, I need to work even harder before the main event...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I had summer camp and all, and...
Shine seems busy too, so we haven't been in touch for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... she's working
incredibly hard in Australia.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Shine often told me that I'm a hard worker...
but to me,
she was so much more of one."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I'm sure.
She must have gotten incredibly strong.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I can't wait... The Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That was when.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hasty footsteps approached from down the hall—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Patter-patter-patter—)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry, excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-Tazuna-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand's eyes go wide as saucers.
And with good reason—it's rare to see
Tazuna-san in such a fluster.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm very sorry
for causing such a scene.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I just received word... and thought I should let the two of you know right away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes... From Australia.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It's about Shine Praise, who transferred from Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down and listen.
Shine Praise-san is—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She sustained an injury during training.
It is severe ligament damage.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They said surgery was necessary
to return to racing, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It will be an extremely difficult surgery.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the case...
it's possible she might... never walk again...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Shine is...?
